elements.text: A new multi-billion-dollar vertical in Southeast Asia
Read it bottom-up: the fare a Navier boat collects today, the market a faster product unlocks — then the whole journey a super-app monetizes around every crossing.
SOM — Navier fare, full SEA network, today's trips, 10% capture
SAM — faster, quieter boats grow the market; 25% capture at maturity
TAM — the entire induced marine-transfer market (≈ 4× SAM; band $3.7–13.2B)
Journey GMV — add food + stays + experiences to every crossing (≈ 3× TAM)
Grab platform revenue on Navier — 18% × Navier-corridor Journey GMV (ceiling $3.9B on full journey GMV)

slides.speakerNotes: Simplified per Jaideep 2026-06-08: SOM(full network,10%)→SAM(induced,25%)→TAM(induced marine, 4×SAM) then journey-GMV (×3) and Grab take (18%). Values from grab-growth-case.json grounded-mid: SOM_full_network $194.9M; SAM_navier $877.2M; TAM_marine = SAM/0.25 = $3.51B; TAM_journey_gmv $10.53B (=3×marine); Grab take = 18%×journey GMV = $1.90B. NOTE: this applies the 18% take to FULL journey GMV ($830M) per Jaideep's explicit formula — the prior deck applied it to the 25%-captured share ($474M). Flagged to Jaideep for confirm.
